The '''''Nemesis''-class patrol ship''' was a [[Patrol ship/Legends|patrol ship]] manufactured by [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]].

==Characteristics==
The ''Nemesis''-class had advanced sensors and computers, was durable, yet light, and had enough storage space for troops or [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]] to be deployed from the craft. The fire-linked guns could be independently operated by dedicated gunners if the ship had a full crew.<ref name="LECG" />

==History==
Created before the [[Sith–Imperial War]], the ''Nemesis''-class was marketed toward smaller worlds and governments in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. In addition to serving local administrations and law enforcement agencies, many ''Nemesis''-class ships ended up in the hands of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], where they were used in operations in the distant and isolated regions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="LECG" />

Black Sun employed a ''Nemesis''-class patrol ship during the [[Skirmish on Iego]].
